MAJIKS STUDIO v1.0.0 - INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS
==================================================

⚠️  IMPORTANT: macOS will block this app because it's not signed.
    This is normal and safe. Follow these steps:

INSTALLATION (3 Simple Steps):
-------------------------------

1. REMOVE QUARANTINE FLAG (Required!)
   Open Terminal and run this command:

   xattr -cr ~/Downloads/MajiksStudio-v1.0.0-macOS.dmg

   (Adjust path if you downloaded to a different location)

2. OPEN THE DMG
   Double-click the DMG file to mount it
   A window will open showing the app

3. DRAG TO APPLICATIONS
   Drag "Majiks Studio.app" to the Applications folder
   Done! You can now open it from Applications.

QUICK COPY-PASTE COMMANDS:
--------------------------
cd ~/Downloads
xattr -cr MajiksStudio-v1.0.0-macOS.dmg
open MajiksStudio-v1.0.0-macOS.dmg

WHAT IF I STILL GET "DAMAGED" ERROR?
-------------------------------------
If you already tried to open the DMG before removing quarantine:

1. Eject the DMG if mounted
2. Run: xattr -cr ~/Downloads/MajiksStudio-v1.0.0-macOS.dmg
3. Mount DMG again
4. If app still shows damaged: xattr -cr /Applications/Majiks\ Studio.app

AFTER INSTALLATION:
-------------------
First launch setup:
1. Install ACE-Step 1.5 (required):
   git clone https://github.com/hyperbayse/ACE-Step-1.5.git ~/ACE-Step-1.5

2. Open Majiks Studio from Applications
3. Enter your license key (format: MS1-xxxxxx-xxxxxx)
4. Configure LLM provider in Settings
5. Start creating music!

SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS:
--------------------
• macOS 14.0 (Sonoma) or later
• Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3) or Intel Mac
• 16GB RAM recommended
• ACE-Step 1.5 for music generation
